chunks: As for what was narrated by Ibrāhīm ibn Hāshim, from al-Ḥusayn ibn Saʿīd, from Ṣafwān ibn Yaḥyā, from ʿĪṣ, from Abī ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام, he said:
I asked him about a man who died while he was junub. He said: “He is washed once with water, then after that he is washed.”

key_terms.جُنُبٌ: a person in the state of janabah requiring ghusl
key_terms.عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّ: from Imam Jaʿfar al-Ṣādiq عليه السلام

ai.seo_question: How should a person who dies in the state of janabah be washed according to this hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning a deceased person who died in the state of janabah. It indicates that the deceased is to be washed in a specific manner, showing the jurisprudential treatment of ritual purity in the rites of the dead.
